description: Establish the canonical Frame Conn SITREP persistence, normalization, legacy compatibility, and clear/migration boundary without activating SITREP runtime or UI behavior.
planning_goal: Establish a canonical SITREP state boundary under scripts/dm_features/sitreps/state. It must use lancer-frame-conn as the canonical Foundry flag namespace, read flags.lancer-sitrep-tracker.sitrep only as centralized compatibility fallback, write only canonical state, distinguish canonical absence from explicit clear so legacy data cannot resurrect after clear, normalize the legacy flat SITREP shape into a stable canonical domain shape, expose read/write/update/clear/migrate operations without Hooks or DOM ownership, keep sitreps-feature-package.js unregistered and inert, mark legacy combat flag compatibility MIGRATED_UNVERIFIED, and update the SITREP assimilation plan to record Phase 1 complete. Do not migrate individual SITREP scenario rules, runtime lifecycle, UI, spatial logic, or elevation/LOS in this patch.

/**
 * scripts/dm_features/sitreps/state/sitrep-state-contract.js
 *
 * Canonical persisted-state contract for Frame Conn SITREPs.
 * This module owns identifiers and shape defaults only; it performs no Foundry I/O.
 */

export const FRAME_CONN_SITREP_FLAG_NAMESPACE = "lancer-frame-conn";
export const FRAME_CONN_SITREP_FLAG_KEY = "sitrep";

export const LEGACY_SITREP_FLAG_NAMESPACE = "lancer-sitrep-tracker";
export const LEGACY_SITREP_FLAG_KEY = "sitrep";

export const FRAME_CONN_SITREP_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export const FRAME_CONN_SITREP_TYPES = Object.freeze([
  "control",
  "escort",
  "extraction",
  "gauntlet",
  "holdout",
  "recon"
]);

});
